slots.title: Regulator publishes stablecoin framework draft
slots.author: Policy Desk
slots.summary: A draft framework sets reserve, disclosure, and redemption rules for fiat-backed stablecoins.
slots.background: Stablecoin: a crypto token pegged to fiat. Previous drafts stalled over reserve rules; this draft revives them with redemption timelines.
perspectives: Industry: clarity will unlock compliant products.
Critics: reserve rules may favor large issuers.

slots.title: Bridge exploit disclosed, patch released
slots.author: Security Team
slots.summary: Developers disclosed a bridge vulnerability, froze affected contracts, and released a patch.
slots.background: Bridge: software moving assets between blockchains — a frequent exploit target. Last year saw similar freezes before patched migrations.

slots.title: New open model matches frontier on reasoning tests
slots.author: Research Blog
slots.summary: Model weights released with evals showing strong math and code reasoning.
slots.background: Open weights let anyone run and inspect the model. Frontier here means best closed models on math/code evals.

slots.title: AI safety bill: what actually changes
slots.author: Policy Analyst
slots.summary: Separates reporting duties from voluntary commitments in the AI safety bill.
slots.background: Safety bill follows voluntary lab commitments. Key terms: reporting duties (mandatory) vs pledges (optional).

slots.title: Decentralized GPU markets meet AI demand
slots.author: Tech Desk
slots.summary: Crypto-powered compute marketplaces sell idle GPU time to AI workloads.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain
slots.background: GPU shortage pushed AI training costs up. Crypto miners repurposed idle hardware into compute marketplaces.
